p: can no more go out and: I can no longer execute my office.
before your face: Into your hands.
of a good courage: For he that must govern the people, must be valiant to repress evil, and constant to maintain virtue.
go before thee: Signifying that man can never be of good courage, unless he is persuaded of God's favour and assistance.
before the LORD thy God in: Before the Ark of the covenant, which was the sign of God's presence, and the figure of Christ.
have not known any thing: Who were not born when the law was given.
cloud: In a cloud that was fashioned like a pillar.
hide my face from them: That is, I will take my favour from them; as turning his face toward us shows his favour.
song for you: To preserve you and your children from idolatry, by remembering God's benefits.
then will they turn unto other: For this is the nature of flesh, no longer to obey God, than it is under the rod.
testify against them as a witness: That these evils are come upon them, because they have forsaken me.
witness against thee: Of your infidelity, when you turn away from the doctrine contained in it.
officers: As governors, judges and magistrates.
work of your hands: By idolatry, and worshipping images, which are the work of your hands.
